subject: Boot-camp camp-to-courtyard companion follow and attack trace
scope: Emulator diagnostic with the recovered 1.16.5.0 client and original boot-camp navmesh; not final-live footage or proof of original encounter balance
confidence: High for the logged movement and hits in these disposable runs; low for whether their path, speed or fight matches final live.

The live server and production databases were untouched. The disposable character database and game binary were restored after these runs.

The camp-to-courtyard straight-path corners jump from (343.20,122.11,108.80) to the destination; the query does not describe the physical jump animation or prove the route is retail accurate.

stationary_checkpoint_diagnostic.setup: The copied character database initially placed Alden at (316.13,120.28,85.93), rather than the intended camp point. He remained stationary; this is a checkpoint diagnostic, not a continuous run.
stationary_checkpoint_diagnostic.result: All three companions began at their camp placements and reached within about 3 m of the player by 16:31:59.033, about 19.5 s after MapLoaded. The trace shows they can follow across the upper gap in the present server geometry when the player waits. They did not reach courtyard attack range in this run.

continuous_run.setup: The disposable character was reset before login to the staged camp point (383.94,119.5,153.83), yaw -0.18. The same native-client movement and screenshot command sequence as camp-to-courtyard-sidejump-continuous-04 was replayed without a post-login movement edit.
continuous_run.result: MapLoaded occurred at 16:33:30.344. All three companions were logged following along the rocky descent and upper gap; at 16:34:35.699 all three were at the player's sandbag position (301.26172,119.90234,77.54297). The first companion hits landed at 16:34:36.402. Before Alden died at 16:34:58.610, companions 198688, 198689 and 198690 each logged nine hits on Thrax 198665. They continued attacking after his death and killed that Thrax at 16:35:03.125. The recruit made no attacks and never entered the cave trigger.
continuous_run.comparison_limit: The earlier continuous replay logged no companion outgoing hits and used a different game binary. The present capture proves follow and attacks in this rebuilt disposable run, but the precise cause of the difference is unresolved. Inspection and command pauses make the death and pacing unsuitable as retail balance evidence.
